steps.content:
Buy from **A - Brackmoor Sound**.

The two listings are for the identical product - the Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - and on everything except seller reputation, they are exactly the same:

|  | A: Brackmoor Sound | B: Ottervale Audio |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Stock / Shipping | In stock. Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days | In stock. Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days |
| Returns | 30-day returns, buyer pays return shipping, refund to original payment method | 30-day returns, buyer pays return shipping, refund to original payment method |
| Warranty | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| Specs | 40hr battery, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3, ANC with transparency, 254g, graphite | Identical |
| **Customer rating** | **4.8 out of 5 (1,900 reviews)** | **4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)** |

Since price, shipping, returns, warranty, and specifications are tied, the deciding factor is track record:

1. **Higher satisfaction:** 4.8/5 vs 4.3/5
2. **Much more evidence:** 1,900 reviews vs 210 reviews - far more customers have bought from Brackmoor and rated them highly, so that rating is much more reliable.

There's no reason to choose Ottervale Audio when it costs the same but has a lower, less-established rating.
